text.description_html:
Acorn AT7BR, Spear Tip Forged Rim Latches Sets For Exterior And Interior Doors

This Iron Rim Latch Set for Exterior And Interior Doors comes with a spear tip handle for both the exterior and the interior and an easy flip down locking device for privacy. It is made from iron so that it will be sure to add an authentic old world touch to any lightweight door. Made by Acorn, it has a smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged.

Specifications: of the Spear Tip Forged Iron Rim Latch Set:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reversible.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 7-3/4"
  • Handle Width: 2"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
